description: Modbus TCP unit; the manual documents only the system registers (user LEDs, storage status)
source: Edge E411 Modbus map v2.0, Unipi technology

sources.title: Edge E411 Modbus map
sources.note: Holding registers and Coils sheets (Unit ID 0), Description sheet

notes: Registers are 0-based. Bit numbers: 0 = LSB, 15 = MSB. 32-bit values are assumed low word first (CDAB), as on the Unipi extensions; the manual does not state the word order.
Registers marked Reserved in the manual are left out.
Transport is not stated in the manual; Modbus TCP on port 502 is assumed.
All registers in this map are on Unit ID 0; the manual lists no Unit ID 1 tables for this model.
